messages:
alex: heads-up: invoice preview vs final ledger diverged ~3.9% for some tenants. traced to proxy-shim retry path dropping the `x-route-tag` header on replayed requests.

maria: can you show an example event?

alex: tailing metering topic gave this: 

```
kafka-console-consumer --topic metering-events --from-beginning --max-messages 20 | jq '{tenant,op,headers}'
# -> {tenant: \"t-999\", op: \"token_charge\", headers: {}}  // missing x-route-tag
```

jamal: is the shim creating a brand new event on retry instead of reusing original metadata?

sasha: looks like the retry wrapper calls emit() with a fresh meta bag. earlier versions copied headers; a refactor removed that copy.

kyle: fallout: invoice preview uses route_tag to split charges by route. missing tag means charges land in the fallback bucket, so preview shows less per-route charge than ledger after post-processing fixes it.

maria: immediate mitigation? block new retries in shim for high-volume tenants? or patch to preserve headers?

alex: hotfix to preserve headers is straightforward. I can push a canary soon. blocking retries is risky for latency.

ops-bot: alert: invoice_preview.delta > 2% for tenants [t-42, t-999, t-314] (window: 2h)

billing-bot: snapshot: {window: \"2h\", pct_delta: 3.92, count_affected_invoices: 7}

jamal: long-term we need observability: per-route coverage metric and an explicit "coverage health" shown next to Invoice Preview so product/support can triage quickly.

sasha: propose small UI change: show "route coverage" percent, and list top 10 events missing tags with link to raw event. low friction.

kyle: also add a backend metric: fraction_of_events_with_route_tag_by_tenant. hook that into alerting (warn at 97%, critical at 90%).

maria: +1. add a heatmap in console: tenant x route coverage. that helps sales/support decide credit requests.

alex: plan: 1) push shim patch to canary (v1.12.4-canary) now, monitor 30m, 2) if green, promote to 25% for 4h then full. 3) add coverage metric pipeline (prometheus exporter + consumer job) and a small frontend tile. 4) backfill plan if finance requests credits.

jamal: backfill options? naive reprocess raw rdlogs and replay missing headers, but need idempotency guard. run with ledger-check join on request_id and only emit if ledger lacks event.

alex: estimate reprocess cost: 48h of raw logs for affected partitions ~ 10 node-hours. with autoscale we can do it in ~2h but need approval for cost.

maria: I'll coordinate with finance for cost approval if customers ask.

sasha: quick UX improvement we can ship today: a soft-warning banner in preview UI: \"Route coverage: 93% — some per-route charges may be incomplete. Click to see examples.\"

kyle: agree, less support churn. also add a link to run a live sample query for a tenant so SEs can verify.

alex: rolling canary now (deploy-bot: deploying shim v1.12.4-canary). will post results.

deploy-bot: deploy started v1.12.4-canary at 2025-05-06T09:12:03Z

ops-bot: monitoring note: watch for increases in duplicate-request counters if backfill emits stale events. add idempotency token to replayed events.

jamal: postmortem items: add unit test to retry wrapper that ensures headers survive, document the contract in the router SDK, and add an ingest-side enrichment fallback that only runs in emergencies.

maria: timeline: hotfix & canary -> 30m monitor -> 25% for 4h -> full (~1 day). coverage metric & UI -> 3 dev days. backfill scoping -> 1 day to produce invoice delta list.

alex: I'll also add a dashboard card that surfaces preview vs ledger delta by tenant and link to the coverage metric.

sasha: filing a tiny RFC for the console tile and alerts, assigning to design/pm. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — ping here if you see other anomalous route patterns.

maria: thanks team, will update finance/support after we have the canary results.
